## Take-away messages

::: incremental
- Bulk mixes cell types; deconvolution recovers proportions $p$.
- Reference-based methods need a signature $X$; unsupervised methods need strong priors (@tbl-methods).
- DeCovarT models gene–gene covariance via multivariate Gaussian convolutions (@eq-bulk-gauss).
- Always validate with aliquots (bulk + FACS / scRNA-seq) when possible.
:::
